vb_textbox.text: On your first go you will choose the gnome that is the smallest of the two.With your fingers on the s and k button choose the smallest gnome.s for left k for right as quickly as you can when the gnome appears.Assoon as the basket appears when you see the basket press the space bar to collect the mushrooms.When the mushrooms are two or less switch to clicking on the larger gnome (I forgot this bit) Keep repeating this until the game is finished
